Hi Marta — thanks, the bank letter looks good at first pass. A few items from AP to confirm before we can release funds: 

1) Can you please provide the IBAN and SWIFT/BIC for the beneficiary (IBAN needed for EUR wires). The bank letter lists the account but we'd like the explicit IBAN field.
2) Confirm the beneficiary name exactly as it appears on the account (for payment reconciliation).
3) Please confirm the currency you want to be paid in (EUR or USD). If USD, please confirm whether you accept currency conversion on our side or if you prefer to receive USD-denominated wire.
4) For our audit trail we prefer a voided check or a bank letter that includes a stamped bank seal; the bank statement stub is helpful but not always sufficient for first-time vendors.

Once we have the IBAN/SWIFT and beneficiary name we expect to clear the vendor file and schedule the payment in our next cycle (target payment date: 2026-06-30). If any of the above will take longer than 48 hours, let us know and we'll note a hold.

Legal note: Vivek, if you see any red flags on the W-8BEN-E please advise — otherwise AP will proceed with onboarding as a foreign payee (no 1099).

Thanks,
